title: Not Safe for All: Auditing the Dialect Penalty in Text-to-Image Safety Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2608.29589v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) safety guardrails fail to generalize equitably to non-standard dialects. Evaluating 23,080 paired prompts across five English dialects, we formalize this failure as the dialect penalty, where filters trigger based on linguistic surface features rather than semantic intent. Text-level filters fail in opposing directions: NSFW-T over-flags benign dialect prompts and LatentGuard over-flags toxic ones (bias gaps up to +28.29 pp), while the OpenAI Moderation API under-detects them. A controlled typo ablation confirms this penalty originates from flagging dialectal features, not generic out-of-distribution sensitivity. The pixel-level generator is largely dialect-agnostic; the penalty enters at text processing and cascades unevenly to post-hoc guardrails. We show this bias tracks training data imbalance and is mitigable via group-balanced retraining, with an ablation attributing the gain to balanced exposure rather than to

translated_title: 并非人人安全：审计文生图安全管线中的“方言惩罚”现象
translated_abstract: 文生图安全防护机制无法公平地泛化到非标准方言。通过评估覆盖五种英语方言的23,080个配对提示词，我们将这种失败形式化为“方言惩罚”——即过滤器基于语言的表层特征而非语义意图进行触发。文本级过滤器以相反的方向失效：NSFW-T会过度标记良性的方言提示词，LatentGuard会过度标记有毒的方言提示词（偏差差距高达+28.29个百分点），而OpenAI审核API则存在检测不足的问题。受控的错字消融实验证实，这种惩罚源于对方言特征的标记，而非一般性的分布外敏感性。像素级生成器在很大程度上与方言无关；惩罚在文本处理阶段引入，并级联式地不均匀传播到事后防护机制。我们表明这种偏差与训练数据的不平衡相关，并可通过组平衡重训练来缓解，消融实验将增益归因于平衡曝光而非……
tldr: 该论文揭示文生图安全过滤系统会因方言的表层语言特征而非语义意图，对非标准英语方言提示词产生系统性误判（“方言惩罚”），该偏差源于文本处理阶段和训练数据不平衡，可通过组平衡重训练加以缓解。
en_tdlr: Text-to-image safety filters systematically misjudge non-standard English dialect prompts based on surface linguistic features rather than semantic intent (the "dialect penalty"), a bias rooted in text processing and training data imbalance that can be mitigated through group-balanced retraining.
